parameters.jsonBody: {"query":"Find previous weekly sprint snapshots, repeated blockers, overdue tasks, and project status trends.","filters":{"user_id":"3c-project-status-agent"},"top_k":12}

={{ ({
  model: "Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507",
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "You are a professional project status report generator. Use only the supplied analysis and source data. Do not invent facts. Produce a concise stakeholder-ready Markdown report."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
        "Generate the FINAL REPORT using this exact structure:\n\n" +
        "# Weekly Sprint Status Report\n" +
        "## Date\n" +
        "## Executive Summary\n" +
        "## Sprint Dashboard\n" +
        "| Metric | Value |\n" +
        "|---|---|\n" +
        "| Total Tasks | X |\n" +
        "| Completed | X |\n" +
        "| Completion Rate | X% |\n" +
        "| In Progress | X |\n" +
        "| Blocked | X |\n" +
        "| Overdue | X |\n" +
        "| Unassigned | X |\n\n" +
        "## Blockers and Risks\n" +
        "## Velocity Trend\n" +
        "## Items Stuck More Than One Sprint\n" +
        "## Completed Work\n" +
        "## Prioritized Action Items\n" +
        "## Answer to User Question\n\n" +
        "SPRINT ANALYSIS:\n" +
        $json.choices[0].message.content +
        "\n\nVERIFIED SOURCE DATA:\n" +
        JSON.stringify($('Prepare Agent Context').first().json)
    }
  ],
  temperature: 0.2,
  max_tokens: 1800
}) }}
